description:
## v1.2.5 - Modded-APK cross-analysis: permission hygiene + wider endpoint net

Two community modded Opera builds (vadj's Opera 103.3.5234.91185 mod and ANiK555's Opera Mini mod) were decompiled and diffed against the originals to harvest techniques for this bundle.

**New patch: Remove ad & tracking permissions** (default on, all four supported packages) - deletes ad-profiling/tracking entries from AndroidManifest.xml: Google Privacy Sandbox (ACCESS_ADSERVICES_AD_ID / _ATTRIBUTION / _TOPICS), the Google Advertising ID (AD_ID), Play install-referrer attribution (BIND_GET_INSTALL_REFERRER_SERVICE), READ_BASIC_PHONE_STATE and the Huawei AppGallery telemetry shim. Remove-if-present semantics (5 entries on stable/beta, 4 on GX), plus the android.adservices.AD_SERVICES_CONFIG manifest property when a future build declares one. The permission list mirrors the one the ANiK555 Opera Mini mod strips from its manifest (the only statically readable part of that build - its dexes are DexProtector-protected). Apps must already tolerate every runtime permission being denied, so nothing user-visible can break.

**Disable analytics & tracking: endpoint list extended** from 81 to 93 constants on stable/beta (12 on GX, up from 8): the Pangle/TikTok ad pipeline (*.pangle.io, api16-access-ttp-b.tiktokpangle-b.us, lf-static.tiktokpangle-cdn-us.com, sf16-static.i18n-pglstatp.com, analytics.tiktok.com/i18n/pixel), the Liftoff/Vungle pipeline (logs./events./adx./config.ads.vungle.com), AppsFlyer including its Privacy-Sandbox trigger (privacy-sandbox.appsflyersdk.com) - all hosts enumerated from the string-pool diff of vadj's mod, which deleted the whole Pangle SDK (3,731 com.bytedance.* classes + its IAB OMOID consent stack) - and Google's crash telemetry (*.crashlytics.com, present on GX). Subdomain spellings were consolidated into bare-domain CONTAINS matches; rewrites verified in the patched output dex.

**Validation of our existing approach**: vadj's mod also does not delete Opera's mediation loader - it only excludes split_pangle_ads from its merge and lets the loader fall back to the no-op ads provider, exactly the safety argument documented for Disable ad modules since v1.0.0. His only other change is a self-promotion dialog (com.ap.va.abror), not adopted.

Full E2E re-run on real APKs: all patches pass on Opera stable 103.3.5234.91185 (base + merged), Opera Beta 104.0.5262.91143 (base) and Opera GX 3.3.18 (base). Patch count: 10. Full history in CHANGELOG.md.
